# Converse Desk | [Previous Topic](https://www.sms-magic.com/docs/technical-resources/sms-magic-converse-guide-for-salesforce-users/messaging-guides-and-overviews.html "Previous Topic")[Parent Chapter](https://www.sms-magic.com/docs/technical-resources/sms-magic-converse-guide-for-salesforce-users/messaging-guides-and-overviews.html "Parent Chapter")[Next Topic](https://www.sms-magic.com/docs/technical-resources/sms-magic-converse-guide-for-salesforce-users/overview.html "Next Topic") | Converse Desk is a powerful software solution that takes your CRM investment to a new level. It’s simple to deploy, easy to use, and delivers the most powerful messaging capabilities available today. SMS-Magic empowers text messaging users to engage, win and retain more buyers, creating strong relationships that drive sustainable competitive advantage. SMS-Magic integrates seamlessly with the most popular CRMs, including Salesforce and ZOHO. Our integration is designed to make it simple for CRM users to send, receive and manage their text messaging conversations, while seamlessly accessing the power of their CRM.
